MQ unlink permissions now pass all 17 cases in all three owners. These targeted results do not establish a complete combined-head run.

nodes.title: Match Linux message-queue unlink permissions
nodes.summary: The unlink-permissions correction passes all 17 cases on native Linux, systrap DirectFS, and systrap shared-gofer, with no failures or skips. The unchanged production Nogo check also passed. The revised sticky directory mode and ownership checks match Linux and include a foreign-owner regression.

nodes.title: Fix iptables replacement counter counts
nodes.summary: LargeReplacePayload passes on native Linux and both ordinary systrap owners after using the replaced table’s entry count. Both systrap owners pass all 17 cases. Native retains four separate socket-option/extension failures and two existing skips.

nodes.title: Allow netfilter options on non-raw sockets
nodes.summary: Both IPv4 systrap owners pass all 36 cases; native and both systrap IPv6 owners pass all 21 cases. Netstack Nogo passes ARM64 and AMD64. Native IPv4 retains three unrelated failures: OriginalDstErrors and missing mark revision 1 / CT revision 0 extensions, plus two existing skips.

nodes.title: Honor DAC capabilities in mq_open
nodes.summary: The DAC capability correction passes all 19 cases on native Linux, systrap DirectFS, and systrap shared-gofer, with no failures or skips. MQ and mqfs Nogo also pass. The before run passed natively and failed the two intended capability cases in each gVisor configuration. Ready for contributor review; no PR is open.

nodes.title: Copy netlink memberships in complete words
nodes.summary: Native Linux passes the regression; the old gVisor implementation failed short output lengths 1, 2, 3, 5, 6, and 7. With this correction and the independent rename fixture fix, complete owners pass: native 62 cases with 11 existing skips, and both ordinary systrap variants 67 cases with 6 existing skips each. Netlink Nogo passes ARM64 and AMD64.

nodes.title: Lower loopback before testing rename events
nodes.summary: The fixture lowers loopback before checking rename events and preserves cleanup. With the independent membership-copy correction, complete owners have no failures: native 62 passing cases and 11 existing skips; both ordinary systrap variants 67 passing cases and 6 existing skips each. No dependency between the two fixes is recorded.

nodes.title: Check Linux filesystem reconfiguration effects
nodes.summary: The corrected FsConfigTest.FsConfigReconfigureSucceeds case passes once uncached on native Linux, systrap DirectFS, and systrap shared-gofer, with no failures or skips. The prior native result failed the inode-limit and read-only expectations. The correction is included in the qualification branch. This targeted result does not establish a full mount-test pass or cover the separate Linux 6.15 detached-mount cases.
